description: [Ledger product, entitlement: ledger] Recompute-audit an agent work claim: re-derive a deterministic SHA-256 digest from the claimed inputs and check it against the claimed digest. Returns GREEN (matches), RED (tampered), or UNVERIFIED (no claim supplied). Replay, not opinion. 3 free calls/day, then entitlement 'ledger'.

claimed_digest.description: The agent's claimed SHA-256 digest to verify against. Omit for UNVERIFIED + the recomputed digest.

inputs.description: The work/claim payload to recompute a digest over.

name: audit_work_claim
